changes: Capability byte plane is now the Storage Provider seam: localStorage keeps the owner-signed restricted ingest path; cosStorage hands the browser a scoped presigned part URL and registers no /parts route (DirectUploadOnly).

CreateUpload persists provider_upload_ref from the provider session; CreateUploadPart issues provider-scoped authorization; CompleteUpload assembles through the provider and verifies exact size+SHA-256 before the immutable object exists.
New Storage.ListParts with ProviderParts{Complete, Parts}; local reports part files it holds, COS reports uploaded multipart shards with the provider size and etag.

GetUpload reconciles the owner readback with ProviderParts: a registered shard the provider holds at the exact registered size is reported completed (local falls back to its registered digest as etag). The reconciliation is a view; it does not rewrite capability.upload_chunks.observation_result.

COS Assemble recovers the pre-commit crash window: when the multipart is gone it reads back the content-addressed immutable object, re-verifies size+SHA-256 and finalizes, instead of failing the retry; ListParts reports that finalized state as Complete.

Build worker follows an approved, bounded registry redirect (real TCR answers blob GET with 307 to presigned object storage), picks transport per registry host (InsecureHTTPHosts) while keeping the legacy AllowHTTP behaviour for an empty list, and surfaces the exporter error text.
No new wire fields, DTOs, migrations or packages/contracts changes.

defectsRepaired.behaviour: the retry re-downloads the immutable object, re-verifies size and SHA-256, and finalizes the same operation instead of failing or starting a second upload identity

defectsRepaired.defect: GetUpload returned no completed shards for a direct-to-storage provider, so a refreshed or resumed upload re-sent bytes the provider already held
defectsRepaired.behaviour: only provider-held registered shards at the exact registered size are reported complete; the missing shards remain to be uploaded; the persisted observation is unchanged

CreateUpload opens the provider upload session inside the owner transaction after the package admission check; a provider session whose transaction then fails is not cleaned up by this window's change. Recorded as an observation, not repaired, because moving the call earlier would let a rejected request create provider state.

The mapstructure v1.5.0 module was fetched with GOSUMDB=off (sum.golang.org and proxy.golang.org are unreachable from this sandbox). Its h1 hash matches the published value, but the checksum-database lookup itself is not_run.
Reconciliation deliberately does not mutate capability.upload_chunks.observation_result; a future reader expecting the column to reflect provider-held shards must use GetUpload, not the table.
